title: On Prohibiting the sale of land to strangers
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：prohibit　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prohibit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the herder ① prohibited the sale of land to strangers twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② prohibits the sale of land to strangers year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ prohibit the sale of land to strangers at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ prohibited the sale of land to strangers before — a line in the ledger for December 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Prohibiting the sale of land to strangers twice over, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ prohibit any start in such weather year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Prohibit any start in such weather at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ prohibits any start in such weather twice over every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ prohibited the sale of land to strangers again when nobody else would.

⑩ To prohibit the sale of land to strangers, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody prohibits the sale of land to strangers year after year again and somebody must prohibit the sale of land to strangers twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 禁止（一般过去式 prohibited the sale of land to strangers：1975 年牧人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 禁止（一般现在 prohibits the sale of land to strangers：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 禁止（不定式 to prohibit the sale of land to strangers：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 禁止（过去完成时 had prohibited the sale of land to strangers：1969 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 禁止（动名词 prohibiting the sale of land to strangers 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使不能（prohibit any start in such weather：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使不能这样的天气根本无法动身）
G. v. 使不能（prohibit any start in such weather：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 禁止（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 prohibits any start in such weather，而母亲又一次 prohibited the sale of land to strangers）

answers.why: prohibit 意为“禁止”，1975 年牧人来回两遍禁止禁止把田地卖给外人，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 prohibited。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，自那以后牧人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 prohibits。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯禁止禁止把田地卖给外人”，此处为不定式 to prohibit the sale of land to strangers。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人禁止过，故用过去完成时 had prohibited。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，牧人说“禁止禁止把田地卖给外人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 prohibiting the sale of land to strangers 作主语。
prohibit 意为“使不能”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使不能这样的天气根本无法动身”，should ever 之后用原形 prohibit any start in such weather。
prohibit 意为“使不能”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使不能这样的天气根本无法动身（prohibit any start in such weather at once），以后再也不要提起。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例使不能这样的天气根本无法动身，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 prohibits。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍禁止禁止把田地卖给外人，用一般过去式 prohibited 叙述。
prohibit 意为“禁止”，结尾那句是母亲 1987 年的话：要禁止禁止把田地卖给外人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

多年以后，牧人仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（prohibits the sale of land to strangers）

早在 1969 年就有人禁止禁止把田地卖给外人，十二月那天牧群台账上的一行字就是证据。（had prohibited the sale of land to strangers）

老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻使不能这样的天气根本无法动身，以后再也不要提起。（prohibit any start in such weather，祈使句）
answers: In 1975 the herder prohibited the sale of land to strangers twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three winters on, the herder still prohibits the sale of land to strangers year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to prohibit the sale of land to strangers at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had prohibited the sale of land to strangers long before 1982, and the line in the ledger for December proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 prohibit 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the herder prohibited the sale of land to strangers twice over, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder prohibits the sale of land to strangers year after year whenever the pasture asks.
Prohibiting the sale of land to strangers twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever prohibit any start in such weather year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture prohibits any start in such weather twice over every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother prohibited the sale of land to strangers again, and the pasture remembered that half.
